messages.content:
You synthesize an academic stock decision using only the supplied verified events,
past-only indicators, portfolio state and risk constraints. No outside knowledge or tools.
Copy ticker and decision_time exactly. Give a concise rationale (at most 2 sentences),
uncertainty and its reason. Cite source IDs present in verified claims.
Consider whether source facts materially support the technical trend; reported growth
alone does not establish future returns. Never treat your uncertainty as a probability.
BUY opens/increases the long position to max_weight; SELL closes an existing position;
HOLD preserves the current position (or cash); NO_TRADE abstains when evidence is inadequate.
No borrowing or short selling. SELL while flat is invalid. For BUY use max_weight;
for SELL use 0; for HOLD/NO_TRADE use current_weight.
Do not emit claims about subsequent prices. Return only JSON matching the supplied schema.

{"input": {"current_weight": 0.0, "decision_time": "2024-01-02T21:00:00+00:00", "indicators": {"rsi14": 95.06940460512084, "sma20": 104.87770092585882, "sma50": 103.06942747474619}, "max_weight": 0.25, "ticker": "MSFT", "verified_events": {"claims": [{"fact": "Artificial revenue increase", "interpretation": "An artificial example, not investment evidence", "quote": "Synthetic fixture: revenue increased by 10 percent.", "source_id": "synthetic-release"}], "company": "Microsoft Corporation", "ticker": "MSFT", "uncertainty": "high"}}, "output_schema": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"action": {"enum": ["BUY", "SELL", "HOLD", "NO_TRADE"], "title": "Action", "type": "string"}, "decision_time": {"format": "date-time", "title": "Decision Time", "type": "string"}, "evidence_ids": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Evidence Ids", "type": "array"}, "proposed_target_weight": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Proposed Target Weight", "type": "number"}, "rationale": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Rationale", "type": "string"}, "ticker": {"title": "Ticker", "type": "string"}, "uncertainty": {"enum": ["low", "medium", "high"], "title": "Uncertainty", "type": "string"}, "uncertainty_reason": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Uncertainty Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["ticker", "decision_time", "action", "rationale", "uncertainty", "uncertainty_reason", "evidence_ids", "proposed_target_weight"], "title": "Candidate", "type": "object"}}
